info.title: OdHive API
info.description: Local API of OdHive, used by its web UI and CLI. Every request other than GET/HEAD must carry the header `X-OdHive: 1`.

get.summary: Whether the service is up, and its version.

Instances this service runs (and ended ones not yet stopped), across
projects.

Registered projects. A project whose files cannot be read is listed with
`error` set.

post.summary:
Creates a project folder in the workspace with one `main` instance. Its
Python environment is not set up yet (`has_venv` is false).

409.description: The name or folder is taken

delete.summary:
Unregisters a project; its folder is kept. Refused while an instance
runs.

post.summary:
Installs the missing Python package awaiting confirmation, then restarts
the instance. Returns when the restart is issued.

409.description: Nothing awaits confirmation, or the attempt limit is reached

post.summary: Drops the missing Python package awaiting confirmation.

get.summary: Log entries an instance run by this service holds in memory.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
First sequence number wanted (`next` of the previous page); omitted =
the newest `limit` entries.

409.description: This service does not run the instance

post.summary:
Restarts an instance with the project's current settings (starts it if
it is stopped). Instances run outside this service must be stopped
first.

Starts an instance with the project's current settings. Returns once the
process is spawned (`starting`); status changes follow as events.

409.description: Already running, running elsewhere, no venv, database or ports taken

post.summary:
Stops an instance gracefully (SIGINT, then SIGKILL after 15 s). Works for
instances run outside this service too.

get.summary:
The `odoo.conf` options of the project's Odoo, read with the project's
Python (cached per source tree); the bundled list while it has no venv.

post.summary:
Registers an existing source tree. Registering a registered path again
returns its entry.

delete.summary:
Unregisters a source tree; its files are kept. Refused while a project
uses it.

get.summary:
The `odoo.conf` options of a Community source: from OdHive's cache, else
the list bundled with OdHive. Nothing is run; a project's option list
(`/projects/{name}/schema`) is read with its own Python.

Candidate.description: What would be installed for a missing module.

requirements.description:
What is passed to the installer: the listed lines when trusted by the
project, else just the name.

oneOf.description: `None` = not trusted; installing needs confirmation.

addons_paths.description:
Existing addons folders (absolute paths), used after the project's
own `addons/`.

enterprise.description: Registered Enterprise source id of the same series.

python.description:
Python interpreter (absolute path) for the project's venv; omitted =
detected at setup.

Edition.description: Odoo edition of a registered source tree.

allOf.description: The record header; `None` for text that is not in Odoo's format.

exceptions.description:
Exception lines ending each traceback, e.g.
`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'ldap'`, in log order.

locations.description: `File "...", line N` frames and XML parse locations, in log order.

message.description:
The message: its first line and every continuation line, joined by
`\n`, without trailing whitespace.

truncated.description: Whether lines were dropped because the entry hit its size cap.

Entry.description: One log record, possibly spanning several lines.

code.description: Exit code, if it exited normally.

port_in_use.description: The output said a port was already in use.

signal.description: Signal that killed it, if any.

ExternalRun.description:
An instance that runs outside this OdHive service, e.g. one started by
`odhive start` in a terminal. It can be stopped, not restarted, here.

supervisor.description:
The OdHive process supervising it; `None` = nobody captures its
output.

FixInfo.description: Auto-fix state shown with an instance.

active.description: A missing module is being handled (queued, installing, restarting).

attempts.description: Installs since the instance was started.

oneOf.description: Awaiting confirmation.

HeaderFields.description:
How [`Entry::header`] appears in an entry's JSON (flattened): every
field is present for an Odoo record and absent for unformatted text. For
the OpenAPI document only.

oneOf.description: Severity.

timestamp.description: When the record was logged (UTC, RFC 3339).

oneOf.description: Dependency auto-fix, when enabled.

gevent_port.description: Gevent port, while ports are held.

http_port.description: HTTP port, while ports are held.

port_retried.description: The ports were allocated again after a port race.

oneOf.description: Smart Reload, when enabled.

supervised.description: Started by this OdHive (output is captured). `false` = re-attached.

InstanceInfo.description: What is known about one instance.

InstanceView.description: One instance of a project: its settings and, while it runs, its state.

oneOf.description: Set when it runs outside this service.

gevent_port.description: Pinned gevent port; `None` = allocated at start.

http_port.description: Pinned HTTP port; `None` = allocated at start.

oneOf.description:
State while this service runs it (also after it ended, until it is
stopped or started again).

Level.description: Severity of a record, in increasing order.

Location.description: A source location named in an entry.

function.description: Function the frame is in, when the log names it.

skipped.description:
Entries asked for that were already dropped from memory (the log
file still has them).

enterprise_version.description:
Registers an Enterprise tree for this Odoo series (Enterprise trees
carry no version), e.g. `19.0`.

path.description:
Absolute path of an Odoo 19/20 Community tree, or of an Enterprise
addons tree when `enterprise_version` is given.

default.description: Default value, if Odoo declares one.

flags.description: Command-line flags, e.g. `["-p", "--http-port"]`. Empty for file-only options.

group.description: `--help` section, e.g. `HTTP Service Configuration`; `None` for file-only options.

OdooOption.description: One option, merged across all flags that share a config key.

oneOf.description: `true` / `false`.
Integer.
Floating point number.
Free text.
File system path.
Comma-separated list.
One of a fixed set of values.

OptionSchema.description: All options of one Odoo series.

options.description: Options in Odoo's order (file-only first, then by `--help` group).

oneOf.description: A line of a requirements file.
A module manifest's `external_dependencies['python']`.
A Python module an instance reported missing ([`crate::autofix`]).

PortOwner.description: The OdHive instance a port belongs to.

error.description: Why the project could not be read; the fields below are empty then.

odoo_version.description: Odoo series of its Community source, when that is registered.

seq.description: Position in the instance's log, from 1, never reused.

Record.description: An entry with its sequence number.

ReloadInfo.description: Smart Reload state shown with an instance.

pending_update.description: Modules to update that no running process has loaded yet.

watching.description: The addons folders are being watched.

ReloadMode.description:
What happens when files of the project's custom modules change (see
[`crate::reload`]).

Requirement.description: A validated requirement, normalised to `name[extras]specifiers ; marker`.

SchemaInfo.description: The `odoo.conf` options of an Odoo source.

reason.description: Why the bundled list is used.

SchemaSource.description: Where an option list came from.

SourceEntry.description: One Odoo source tree known to OdHive, shared between projects.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced from projects, e.g. `odoo-19.0`.

odoo_version.description: Odoo series detected from the tree, e.g. `19.0`.

path.description: Absolute path of the source tree.

oneOf.description: Spawned; the HTTP port is not accepting connections yet.

pid.description: Process id (also the process group id).

oneOf.description: The HTTP port accepts connections.
A stop or restart was requested; waiting for the process to exit.
Exited on request, or by itself with code 0.
Exited by itself with a non-zero code or a signal.
A restart could not spawn the process.

killed.description: It did not stop in time and was killed.

oneOf.description: Final status, for an instance this service supervised.
A requirements file or manifest of the project lists it.
The built-in import → package table names it.
